What Life With All-on-X Feels Like
"I caught myself hiding my smile in photos."
Soft foods. Chewing on one side. A hand across the mouth. The workarounds accumulate so slowly that years can pass before you notice how much of life has rearranged itself around your teeth.
"Someone finally showed me the whole picture."
Your jaw is scanned in 3D, your bite is photographed and mapped, and your future smile is designed around your face, so the finish line is visible before treatment even starts.
"By that afternoon, it was behind me."
Dr. Stone places your implants with guided, minimally invasive surgery, and sedation is available. Most patients head home the same day with a fixed temporary arch already in place.
"They feel like they were always mine."
The final arch is built to your bite, your smile, and the way your face moves. The hardest part, patients tell us, is remembering there was ever anything else.
Your case stays in one pair of hands from the first scan to the final arch. No repeating your story to a new provider, no referrals out.
Jawline, lip line, and proportion are mapped before placement. Your new teeth are shaped to fit your face, not chosen from a catalog.
Sedation is available and every case is planned for gentle, minimally invasive treatment, from your first visit through healing.
Complex and atrophic cases are welcome here, including bone loss that other clinics turn away. A 3D scan shows what is possible for you.

children.textContent: A Surgeon's Training. An Artist's Eye.

Dr. Mona Stone's path to surgery started in engineering: a biomedical engineering degree, a Doctorate of Dental Surgery from the University of Missouri-Kansas City, and a full oral & maxillofacial surgery residency across three Level 1 trauma centers. Today she is an attending surgeon at Baylor and Methodist, and implant surgery is the heart of her practice.

Where many surgeons focus only on whether an implant will hold, Dr. Stone reads the whole face (proportion, balance, the line of the jaw) and designs each result to look, feel, and age naturally over the years that follow.
One Tooth or a Whole Arch: The Right Plan for You
Your consultation maps your bone, bite, timeline, and goals, then points to the path that fits. A quick orientation before your visit.
An implant rebuilds a single missing tooth, root and crown, without grinding down the healthy teeth beside it.
A complete row of fixed teeth carried by four to six precisely placed implants. It stays in around the clock. Nothing removable, nothing to take out at night.
Three Visits Between You and a Permanent Smile
A complimentary exam (3D scan included) that maps your bone, bite, and goals, then hands you a clear plan and an itemized quote before anything begins.
Dr. Stone performs the placement with guided, minimally invasive technique; sedation is available. Most patients head home the same day with a fixed temporary arch in place.
Once the implants have fused with the jaw, generally 4 to 6 months, your custom final arch goes in, shaped to your face and made to last.
Every arch below started with a conversation, a 3D scan, and a plan designed around that specific patient. No shortcuts, no standard molds.

children.textContent: How much do All-on-X implants cost?

All-on-X in the Westlake and DFW area typically ranges from about $25,000 to $50,000 or more per arch, depending on the number of implants, materials, and whether any bone work is needed. Stone Dental Implant Center provides a full itemized quote at your consultation, with financing through Lending Club, Cherry, Sunbit and Proceed Finance.

All-on-X replaces an entire arch of teeth using a few strategically placed titanium implants, usually four to six, that support a fixed set of permanent teeth. Unlike dentures, they stay in permanently and function like natural teeth.
Am I a candidate if I have bone loss?

In most cases, yes. Dr. Stone can often angle implants around areas of bone loss or perform grafting and sinus lifts when needed. A 3D scan at your consultation determines your bone density and the right plan for your case, including complex cases other clinics turn away.
Will my new teeth look natural?

Yes. This is the heart of the Stone approach. Your new arch is designed around your face, with the shape, shade, and proportion matched to your features, so the result looks like it always belonged to you.

Coverage varies. Some medical plans, including certain BlueCross BlueShield medical policies, may cover portions of full-arch treatment, and many PPO dental plans cover extractions, grafts, or sedation. We work with most PPO plans as an out-of-network provider and verify your benefits before treatment.
How long does the process take?
Most patients leave with same-day temporary teeth on the day of surgery. The implants then integrate with the jawbone over about 4 to 6 months, after which your custom permanent arch is placed.
The 3D scan at your complimentary consultation maps exactly what your case needs before anything begins.
